variant_instruction: read and follow only the opaque local method bundle supplied in the trial workspace
workspace_policy: fresh public-fixture copy per variant and trial
method_state_policy: unique WEILAN_METHOD_HOME per variant and trial
cross_window_policy: fresh agent session per declared stage with only workspace and scoped method-state continuity
scoring_policy: executor never assigns metrics; independent blinded graders use frozen checks
budget_policy: aggregate tool and context budgets across all stages; overrun invalidates the trial
